Now with assistant, developers can use natural language to build sophisticated analytics faster. Generating ready-to-use SDK code snippets from the designer interface makes collaboration between designers and developers easier than ever. Swift, code-first analytics Create dynamic queries, charts, and filters directly from your application code—no predefined dashboards or widgets required. Empower your developers to be nimble in ever-changing data landscapes, implement feedback and iterate quickly, and stay ahead of the competition. Ready-made components for the AI age Embed AI-powered analytics into your product. Assistant enables natural language query for instant, actionable insights. Our robust platform empowers developers and product teams to seamlessly create flexible embedded analytics experiences, and integrate them into any workflow, driving better user experience.

jobs.title: Connectivity
jobs.description: Skip to Main Content Home > Platform > Data connectivity solutions Connect your data With 200+ connectors, a flexible data engine, and new support for external AI agents, Sisense helps you unlock the full value of your data, whether you connect live, cache queries for faster performance, or take a hybrid approach. Book a live demo Real-time insights with live connection Harness the power of your cloud data warehouse—Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse, and more—without data duplication. Sisense’s live connections let you build semantic models directly on warehouse tables, delivering always-fresh analysis. With MCP, these governed models can also power trusted insights inside external AI tools. Consolidate data using ElastiCube Accelerate your analytics with Sisense’s ElastiCube, a high-performance analytical database built for speed and flexibility. Combine data from multiple sources, perform complex transformations, and deliver fast, AI-ready models that can be used across Sisense and external tools via MCP. Hybrid: The best of both worlds Get the most out of your data infrastructure with the Sisense hybrid approach. Combine the speed of in-memory analytics caching with the depth and flexibility of your data warehouse. With MCP support, your governed models can also power external AI agents, helping users find trusted answers wherever they work.
